identity.title: microVLA: minimal VLA training and inference on a 4 GB laptop GPU
identity.repo_note: Cloned at the commit above. This is the repository requested for the MicroVLA row. Its README describes a 10.5M pi0.5-style model. It does not implement the 12.37M Theia + POTION checkpoint.

distinct_from.name: Ngseo/microvla-seqgru-libero
distinct_from.why: A different 12.37M LIBERO policy: Theia-tiny vision, a frozen POTION text table, a GRU readout, and an L1 chunk head. The RSS workshop title uses the same MicroVLA name.

distinct_from.name: varununayak/microvla
distinct_from.why: A 117,248-parameter RT-2 toy on a synthetic 32x32 reach task.

summary: The cloned repository trains one small pi0.5-style policy from scratch on LIBERO-Spatial. A shared 4-layer ViT embeds two cameras, instruction words and discretized state form the prefix, and a narrower action expert predicts a 16-step chunk with flow matching. Training first matches ViT patches to frozen SigLIP features, then runs the flow-matching loss for 8,000 steps. The README reports 10.5M parameters and 270/300 successes on LIBERO-Spatial. The local 12.4M landscape note matches a different checkpoint, listed under Not the same work.

landscape.paradigm: Local note: distilled vision, static text lookup, and a chunk head. This repository is a pi0.5-style ViT plus flow-matching action expert.
landscape.bottleneck: Embedded controller memory and latency. The README targets a 4 GB laptop GPU.
landscape.hardware_fit: Local note: ideal baseline, about 2–3 GB VRAM. The README's small-model timing is 79 ms per chunk.

data.note: train.py --preprocess --stream wrote runs/libero_cache_96 from HuggingFaceVLA/libero. The manifest records 52,970 frames, 432 episodes, 10 tasks, and 20 validation episodes. extracts/microvla_example.json opens 16 frames of train episode 1261 from that cache.

datasets.name: LIBERO-Spatial
datasets.volume: README and the local manifest agree: 432 demos and 52,970 frames from HuggingFaceVLA/libero, pinned revision 86958911c0f959db2bbbdb107eb3e17c5f9c798e. The manifest holds out 20 validation episodes. Eval default is 10 initial states per task, replan every 5 actions, 220-step limit.
datasets.sampling: A batch draws random frame indices from the train split. The 16 future actions are clamped to the last frame of the same episode. Validation episodes are held out in the cache manifest.
datasets.augmentation: Random replicate-pad shift of 4 pixels on every step. Color jitter is off unless --color-jitter is set. Distillation upsamples the image 2x for SigLIP.

fields.name: images
fields.note: observation.images.image and image2. Default --image-size 96. Scaled by 127.5 into [-1, 1] in the ViT.

fields.name: state
fields.note: Normalized, then each value is discretized into 256 bins.

fields.name: actions
fields.note: A training target is 16 future steps, clamped at the episode end.

fields.name: instruction
fields.note: Whitespace tokenizer built from the task strings. 0 is pad.

golden.description: The target is 16 future 7-d actions from the demonstration, clamped at the episode end.

trained_checkpoint.note: 16 frames of LIBERO-Spatial episode 1261, agent camera, at the eval video rate of 20 fps. The checkpoint is train.py with --distill-steps 0 and --steps 2, so SigLIP distillation was skipped and the optimizer ran twice, not the README 1,000 plus 8,000 schedule. Green bars are that checkpoint's unnormalized 16 by 7 action chunk, flattened row-major to 112. Amber bars are the logged future actions from the cache, flattened the same way.

training_provenance.summary: Training reads fixed LIBERO demonstration frames and 16-step action chunks. The learned policy does not write the training set.

model.overview: MicroVLA is a joint prefix and action-expert transformer. Vision is a ViT of 4 layers at width 192 with 8-pixel patches, shared by both cameras plus a camera embedding. Six joint blocks run a width-256 prefix and a width-128 action expert in the same attention. The LIBERO config sets 2 cameras, state 8, action 7, and horizon 16. Class defaults in Config are the toy sizes and are not the LIBERO run.

total_params.name: README parameter split
total_params.value: parameter_counts() printed vision 1,893,952, backbone 5,704,704, action expert 2,265,600, embeddings and heads 616,455, total 10,480,711. The README rounds that split to 10.5M, 1.9M, 5.7M, and 2.3M.

modules.name: Vision
modules.detail: Conv patch embed, 4 pre-norm TransformerEncoder layers, width 192, then a linear map to the prefix width.

modules.name: JointBlock
modules.detail: Six layers. Prefix width 256 with GeGLU MLP 1024. Expert width 128 with adaRMSNorm on the flow time. 4 query heads and 1 KV head, RoPE.

modules.name: MicroVLA
modules.detail: Embeds images, state bins, and instruction tokens, then denoises the action chunk. sample() takes Euler steps; loss() is the flow-matching MSE.

model.runtime: uv sync installed the repo. train.py --preprocess --stream --image-size 96 wrote runs/libero_cache_96 and exited 0; the manifest has 52,970 frames. train.py --distill-steps 0 --steps 2 --batch-size 4 --logger none ran on an RTX 5070 Ti, exited 0, and saved runs/paper-card/latest.pt. parameter_counts() printed total 10,480,711. capture_example.py then called MicroVLA.sample on 16 frames of episode 1261. infer.py was not used: it loads pretrained pi0.5, not this model. Distillation was skipped and two steps are not the README schedule of 1,000 plus 8,000. See extracts/run_preprocess.txt, extracts/run_train.txt, and extracts/run_example.txt.

compute.name: Training defaults
compute.value: 1,000 distillation steps at batch 16 and lr 1e-3, then 8,000 flow-matching steps at batch 32 and lr 3e-4. AdamW, weight decay 0.01, grad clip 1, 100-step warmup and cosine decay. CUDA autocast is bf16.

sources.locator: train.py main defaults and the step loop

compute.name: Local two-step run
compute.value: RTX 5070 Ti. train.py --distill-steps 0 --steps 2 --batch-size 4 --logger none. Step 2 train loss 1.3137191534042358, validation loss 1.264892578125, peak VRAM 327.6865234375 MB. This is not the README schedule.

compute.name: Reported small-model result
compute.value: README: LIBERO-Spatial 270/300 (90%), mean 79 ms per action chunk. The same README times pi0.5 NF4 on an RTX 3050 4 GB.

objectives.name: Flow-matching loss
objectives.explanation: The code draws t from the inverse CDF of Beta(1.5, 1), scaled into (0.001, 1). The noisy action is t * noise + (1 - t) * action. The network regresses noise minus the clean action. The README writes the same path with the opposite interpolation symbol; the linked function is the one that trains.

symbols.meaning: Gaussian noise of the same shape.

objectives.name: SigLIP patch distillation
objectives.explanation: For 1,000 steps only the ViT and a linear head train. One camera is chosen at random. Its image is upsampled 2x and passed through a frozen SigLIP-B/16. The loss is one minus cosine similarity plus MSE, after layer-norm on the teacher tokens.

symbols.meaning: Linear head from prefix width to the SigLIP width.

train.text: Stream or read HuggingFaceVLA/libero and write a cache of two camera images, 8-d state, and 7-d actions.
Build MicroVLA with 2 cameras, 8-d state, 7-d actions, and the requested horizon, default 16.
For 1,000 steps, distill a random camera's ViT features onto frozen SigLIP with cosine plus MSE.
For 8,000 steps, sample a batch, shift-augment the images, and step AdamW on MicroVLA.loss.

infer.text: Load the checkpoint into TinyPolicy, resize both cameras, normalize state, and tokenize the instruction.
Cache the prefix, start the chunk from noise, and take Euler steps of the velocity. Default sample() uses 10 steps.
Unnormalize and clamp actions to [-1, 1]. Closed-loop eval executes the first 5 of the chunk, then replans.

task.action: 7-d normalized action. The training chunk is 16 steps.
task.horizon: Closed-loop eval executes 5 actions, then replans. The spatial suite limit in the eval script is 220 steps.
task.contact: Images and an 8-d state. No wrench or torque input.
task.latency: README: 79 ms per action chunk for the 10.5M model.
task.data: README: 432 demos and 52,970 frames from LIBERO-Spatial. Two cameras at 96 px.

sources.locator: train.py LIBERO config and eval replan default

parts.choice: Shared 4-layer ViT, width 192, patch 8, then a linear map into the prefix.
parts.inputs: Two uint8 cameras, default 96 px, scaled into [-1, 1].
parts.outputs: Patch tokens, plus a learned camera embedding when two cameras are used.
parts.frozen: SigLIP-B/16 is frozen and used only as the distillation teacher.
parts.trained: The ViT, including the patch projection.
parts.breaks_if: The image side is not a multiple of 8, or the camera count differs from the two-camera LIBERO config.

evidence.claim: The published result is for the whole system. This slot was not isolated.

parts.choice: Whitespace tokenizer over the task string, embedded with the discretized state.
parts.inputs: Token ids. Pad id 0 is dropped from the attention mask.
parts.outputs: Prefix tokens concatenated after the image tokens.
parts.frozen: Nothing in this slot stays frozen during the action-training phase.
parts.breaks_if: The instruction vocabulary differs from the cache tokenizer built for these task strings.

evidence.claim: The published result is for the whole system. This slot was not isolated.

parts.choice: A prefix KV cache for one chunk. No state is carried into the next replan.
parts.inputs: Cached prefix keys and values, the noisy action chunk, and the flow time.
parts.outputs: A 16-step action velocity. The cache is rebuilt at the next observation.
parts.frozen: The cache is an inference reuse of the prefix, not a learned memory module.
parts.trained: Nothing extra. The cache is computed from the current observation.
parts.breaks_if: The task needs information from earlier than the current cameras, state, and instruction.

evidence.claim: No long-horizon memory comparison was reported for this repository.

parts.choice: Flow matching over a 16 by 7 chunk. Euler sampling defaults to 10 steps.
parts.inputs: Noisy actions, flow time, and the prefix.
parts.outputs: Velocity with the same shape as the chunk.
parts.frozen: Nothing in the action expert stays frozen during the train phase.
parts.breaks_if: The action is not a 7-d chunk, or the horizon changes without retraining.

evidence.claim: The published result is for the whole system. This slot was not isolated.

parts.choice: Unnormalize the chunk, clamp to [-1, 1], and execute the first 5 actions.
parts.inputs: The sampled 16 by 7 chunk and the dataset action statistics.
parts.outputs: Seven robot commands per control step.
parts.frozen: The policy weights stay fixed at eval.
parts.breaks_if: The robot does not accept the 7-d normalized LIBERO action.

evidence.claim: The published result is for the whole system. This slot was not isolated.

parts.choice: 1,000 steps of SigLIP cosine-plus-MSE, then 8,000 steps of flow-matching MSE.
parts.inputs: Images, state, instruction, and the action chunk. Distill uses one random camera.
parts.frozen: SigLIP is frozen. During distillation only the ViT and a linear head train.
parts.trained: The full MicroVLA during the flow-matching phase.
parts.breaks_if: The run skips distillation or replaces the flow target noise minus action.

evidence.claim: The published result is for the whole system. This slot was not isolated.

gaps: No PDF is in this repository. The RSS workshop paper that shares the MicroVLA name was not downloaded.
infer.py benchmarks a separate pi0.5 checkpoint on a 4 GB GPU. Those timings are not this model's forward pass.
The example checkpoint took two AdamW steps and skipped SigLIP distillation, so it is not the README 1,000 plus 8,000 run and the 270/300 LIBERO-Spatial result was not reproduced.
